question:
Identify the famous Indian classical dancer.

She is a Guru of both Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing style. She received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1987.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh **is a renowned Indian classical dancer who has received several awards and accolades for her contribution to the field of dance. She is known for her proficiency in both Bharatanatyam and Odissi dance styles.
 
• She was born in Mumbai in 1944 and started learning dance at a young age. She later trained under renowned gurus like Kelucharan Mohapatra and Hema Malini.
 
• In 1977, she founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances in New Delhi, which has since become a hub for promoting and preserving traditional Indian dance forms.
 
• Apart from her contributions to dance, Sonal Mansingh is also a well-known social activist and has been involved in various causes like women's empowerment and environmental conservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shovana Narayana is also a well-known Indian classical dancer who has specialized in Kathak dance style. She has received several awards for her contributions to dance and has also been involved in social causes like HIV/AIDS awareness.
 
• Padma Subrahmanyam is another prominent Indian classical dancer who has specialized in Bharatanatyam dance style. She has received several awards and has also been involved in research and documentation of traditional dance forms.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was a legendary Indian classical dancer who was known for her proficiency in Bharatanatyam and Kathakali dance styles. She founded the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad, which has since become a leading institution for promoting dance and theatre.
